svg.title: esum-site-author architecture
svg.text: from a URL to a working, documented ESUM site
gives a URL and the questions to ask
logs in themselves when a login is needed
asks for any write; okays a trigger skill
11 steps, each ends on a “Done when”
three kinds: engine config · standalone module · Markdown site
registered by folder layout, no central list
read by agents through esum docs <site>
free site name, URL, login needed?
T1, T1 + browser UA, T2, challenges
source, ids, paging, transport per action
• replay it only if it is a tier-0 read
• a failing write: read its error, run
CLI live run or full check
7 runs its browser steps once, read-only
8 SITE.md is the doc; verified: after 7
9 dogfood via SITE.md; fixes edit it
every read action once, real site
LOGIN NEEDED: go on, report at end
a write runs only if the user asks
re-check every earlier friction; new questions
use real ids seen in earlier rounds
tier-0 reads only · repeat while friction
rerun the site’s own offline tests
every path ends in the Report
custom: offer it, write only if agreed
Markdown site: SITE.md only, its own doc
this repo · only when asked, or meant to ship
writes only when the user asks
